q: 我以前在这家公司工作___。
en: I used to work at this company.

q: 小王以前当___护士。
en: Xiao Wang used to be a nurse.

q: 我小时候学___游泳。
en: I took swimming lessons when I was a child.

q: 这个病我以前得___，所以知道怎么办。
en: I had this illness before, so I know what to do.

q: 他在国外读___书，所以英语很好。
en: He has studied abroad, so his English is good.

q: 我以前跟这位经理合作___，所以很了解他的工作习惯。
en: I have worked with this manager before, so I know his work habits well.

q: 我爸爸年轻时踢___足球，现在膝盖不好。
en: My dad played football when he was young; now his knees are bad.

q: 我以前在那家医院住___，护士都很好。
en: I stayed at that hospital before; the nurses were all very nice.

q: 他以前做___老师，所以很会讲道理。
en: He used to be a teacher, so he is good at explaining things.

q: 她曾经在一家大医院当___护士长，所以很会管理病人。
en: She was once a head nurse at a big hospital, so she is good at managing patients.

q: 我妈妈教___书，所以她很会说话。
en: My mom has taught school, so she is good at talking.

q: 王经理年轻的时候也当___兵，所以身体特别好。
en: Manager Wang also served in the army when he was young, so he is in great shape.

q: 老板以前也在小公司做___，所以他很理解我们的难处。
en: The boss has also worked at a small company, so he understands our difficulties.

q: 我弟弟小时候吃___这种水果，所以不喜欢。
en: My younger brother tried this fruit as a child, so he does not like it.

q: 我们以前见___面___。
en: We have met before.

q: 他结___婚___，现在一个人住。
en: He has been married before; now he lives alone.

q: 我们在公司的晚会上跳___舞___。
en: We have danced at a company party.

q: 小王在这家公司加___班___。
en: Xiao Wang has worked overtime at this company.

q: 你在海边游___泳___吗？
en: Have you ever swum at the seaside?

q: 听说李经理年轻的时候在国外留___学___。
en: I heard Manager Li studied abroad when he was young.

q: 我___去过那家医院，不知道在哪儿。
en: I have never been to that hospital, so I don't know where it is.

q: 他___吃过北京烤鸭。
en: He has never eaten Beijing roast duck.

q: 我没吃过这种药___，不知道有没有用。
en: I have never taken this medicine, so I don't know if it works.

q: 他来这家公司三年了，还___请过假。
en: He has been at this company three years and still hasn't taken any leave.

q: 这个病我没得___，所以不太了解。
en: I've never had this illness, so I don't know much about it.

q: 我小时候很健康，一次医院也没住___。
en: I was very healthy as a child and was never in hospital once.

q: 小王来公司已经半年了，可是还没跟经理单独开___会。
en: Xiao Wang has been at the company half a year but has not yet had a one-on-one meeting with the manager.

q: 这么多年来，他连一天假都没请___。
en: In all these years he has not taken even one day off.

q: 他去___上海，下个星期回来。
en: He has gone to Shanghai and will be back next week.

q: 这个电影我以前看___，不想再看了。
en: I've seen this film before and don't want to watch it again.

q: 医生去___病房，一会儿就回来。
en: The doctor has gone to the ward and will be right back.

q: 昨天晚上我们开___一个很长的会，大家都很累。
en: We had a very long meeting last night and everyone is tired.

q: 他去___外地出差，现在还没回来。
en: He has gone away on a business trip and isn't back yet.

q: 小李来___，你快去见他。
en: Xiao Li is here; go and see him quickly.

q: 昨天下午我去医院检查___身体，医生说我没问题。
en: Yesterday afternoon I went to the hospital for a checkup, and the doctor said I was fine.

q: 老板今天早上开___三个会，现在在休息，你下午再来吧。
en: The boss had three meetings this morning and is resting now; come back this afternoon.

q: 他以前做___部门经理，现在是普通职员。
en: He used to be a department manager; now he is an ordinary employee.

q: 我去过___次那家医院。
en: I have been to that hospital twice.

q: 这个同事我只见过三___。
en: I have met this colleague only three times.

q: 我找过___他___，他都不在办公室。
en: I have looked for him twice and he wasn't in the office either time.

q: 不用了，我吃___了，谢谢。
en: No need, I've already eaten, thanks.

q: 早饭我已经吃___了，你不用给我留。
en: I've already had breakfast; you don't need to save any for me.

q: 你洗___澡了吗？
en: Have you had your shower yet?

q: 病人的血压，护士已经量___了。
en: The nurse has already taken the patient's blood pressure.

q: 他的药还没___呢，你提醒他一下。
en: He has not taken his medicine yet; remind him.

q: 会议室我已经打扫___了，大家可以进去了。
en: I have already cleaned the meeting room; everyone can go in now.

q: 你做___这种检查吗？
en: Have you ever had this kind of examination?

q: 你有没有请过假___？
en: Have you ever taken leave?

q: 你写___写过这种报告？
en: Have you ever written this kind of report?

q: 你问我写过报告没有？我___，写过很多。
en: You ask whether I have written reports? Yes, many.

q: 你看过___次医生？
en: How many times have you seen a doctor?

q: 我从来___生过病。
en: I have never been ill.

q: 医生说我很健康，我从来没生___大病。
en: The doctor says I am healthy; I have never had a serious illness.

q: 我从来___喝咖啡，因为喝了就睡不着。
en: I never drink coffee, because I cannot sleep if I do.

q: 我从来没见过这么爱加班___人。
en: I have never seen anyone so fond of working overtime.
